historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes proprietary package but fails to protect boot/production disks.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds dedicated disposable target, write semantics and BLOCKED condition for ambiguous scope.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Read-only inventory or SMART cannot replace destructive FIO coverage.

original_test_intent: Qualify the approved NVMe SSDs with the vendor-defined FIO read/write/IOPS sequence and verify performance, integrity and device health against the platform oracle.
original_method: Pin NVQual/FIO config; map serial/namespace/device to physical slot and prove targets are dedicated disposable media; capture mount/LVM/RAID/boot usage and backup; approve destructive pattern/runtime/queue/block parameters and thresholds; unmount/isolate; run bounded jobs; validate data/SMART/error/performance; sanitize or restore only per plan and confirm re-enumeration/health.
manual_activity: Storage owner selects disposable namespaces, confirms backups and authorizes destructive writes; operator owns remount/recovery.
required_inputs: Signed NVQual/FIO artifact and exact job
Proof targets are non-boot/non-production and unmounted
Read/write pattern, block size, depth, runtime and pass thresholds
Backup, abort, restore/sanitize and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Hard-block ambiguous, mounted, boot, RAID/LVM or production targets
Resolve by serial/namespace, never /dev enumeration alone
No automatic retry or target expansion
agent_execution_scope: Validate immutable target allowlist and destructive approval
Restore/re-enumerate per plan and report without DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The guessed token neither identifies devices nor specifies destructive FIO jobs.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Invoke only the pinned vendor module/job against an explicit serial/namespace allowlist after unmounted disposable-media proof.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Read, write, IOPS and other SSD measurements are retained; no safe-looking read-only substitution is made.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every FIO job to SSD serial and namespace with preflight exclusion of system/production storage and per-device thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds destructive-target governance and measurable acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Inventory/FW readability cannot prove read/write performance or integrity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Writes can irreversibly destroy data and consume SSD endurance; some cleanup is itself destructive.

project_override_considerations: Project storage design governs namespace ownership, RAID/LVM participation, endurance budget and post-test restoration.
expected_evidence: Raw FIO results/exits and per-device metrics

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires destructive SSD performance qualification while Criteria only check readable text and firmware version.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A dedicated disposable target can make execution possible; any ambiguous or protected target is a run-time hard block, not a global review stop.

review_improvement: Adds explicit protection against wiping boot or production storage while preserving the source's required writes and measurements.
independent_technical_reasoning: FIO device paths can change across boots and a write test can immediately overwrite filesystems or metadata. Only serial/namespace identity plus mount/stack exclusion and deliberate data-loss approval can make the original write coverage safe; a generic command is unacceptable.
